title: Generalized Anxiety Disorder 7 Item Scale (GAD-7)
column_headers: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

questions_score.text: 1. Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
2. Not being able to stop or control worrying
3. Worrying too much about different things?
5. Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
7. Feeling afrais as if something awful might happen
